description: React component implementing the game container for a Tic Tac Toe web app, managing game state, handling user interactions, and rendering child components.

methods.name: GameContainer
methods.description: Main React functional component that maintains game state, handles user interactions, and renders the game UI.

methods.name: handleSquareClick

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state.
